notes.title: Desolate Update: Updated animations and reworked respawns
Desolate Update: bugfixes and improvements
notes.notes:
Hello Volunteers!

Welcome to another Desolate update. In this update, we've fixed a lot of in-game bugs that were bothering you. The list is attached!


 Fixed shooting NPCs - captains now support attacks with fire
 Fixed bipedal NPCs attacking four-legged players
 NPCs no longer turn after the player when they are stunned
 NPCs of the same faction no longer fight against each other 
 Items that the player can pick up are now visibly highlighted
 Fixed a bug with losing control after getting kicked in a fight with an NPC 
 Added a voiceover when hitting a block
 NPCs no longer dragged their feet when standing close to a wall or fence 
 No more getting their kicks stuck in walls during fights in cramped quarters
 Updated a lot of models and textures of the environment
 Fixed bugs with Blindman
 Improved sets of physical reactions to blows on NPC people


Thank you for the feedback you give! It helps us make Desolate better. If you've witnessed a bug, please let us know in the comments under this news or on our Discord: https://discord.gg/thd7SUcu

notes.title: Updated combat AI and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Hello Volunteers!

We’d like to present the next Desolate update to you. Today’s menu features improved combat artificial intelligence, new NPC animations and fixed bugs.

List of improvements 

Improved Combat AI:

 New NPC behavior in combat: more tactical attacks on the player
 Fixed unrealistic NPC dodging
 Also, NPCs got some new melee animations


Bug fixes:

 Fixed game crashes
 Fixed bug when pressing tab would cause a player character to run endlessly 


Improved melee combat:

 Fixed a bug where a punch could go through an opponent
 Improved NPCs' reactions to blows to make it clearer when a blow reaches the target


Feedback 
Thank you for staying with us and giving us your feedback! 

Feel free to write your feedback about this update in the comments below this post, or on the Desolate Discord server:  https://discord.gg/AubFteC8  

Thanks for your help, volunteers!

Hello Volunteers! Today we invite you to test the next Desolate update. 

List of improvements 

As before, the purpose of public testing is to test new features and fixes that will hit the game in the future. To put it simply, play for fun, test the game and pay attention to the new features.

Improved Combat AI:

 New NPC behavior in combat: more tactical attacks on the player
 Fixed unrealistic NPC dodging
 Also, NPCs got some new melee animations


Bug fixes:

 Fixed game crashes
 Fixed bug when pressing tab would cause a player character to run endlessly 


Improved melee combat:

 Fixed a bug where a punch could go through an opponent
 Improved NPCs' reactions to blows to make it clearer when a blow reaches the target


How to participate in the beta test

Important: please note that the beta test may overwrite your autosaves - normal saves will not be affected. However, we advise you to make a backup copy of your saves and move them to another folder just in case. 


 You need to have a purchased copy of Desolate in your Steam library. 
 Go to your Steam library in your profile, find Desolate, right-click on it, and click "Properties.
 Select the "Beta Tests" tab.
 Select Beta test Development
 Enter password: 4ewilCSA8kllq6d5u899
 Close the "Properties" window and wait until the game is updated 
 Turn on the game after updating. Play the Prologue Desolate or start the walkthrough in the open world. 


How to return from beta mode to classic build:

 Go to your Steam library in your profile, find Desolate, right-click on it and click "Properties".
 Select the "Beta Tests" tab.
 Click on the Beta Tests tab and select no beta there
 Wait for Steam to update the game to its normal state


Feedback 
You can write your feedback in the comments below this update or on the Desolate Discord server: https://discord.gg/AubFteC8 

Thanks for your help, volunteers!

notes.title: Customization and Bugfixes
Some improvements and bugfixes
Desolate: Bugfix #2
Major Update: combat, FPS boost, character appearance and improved lighting
notes.notes:
Hello, Volunteers! 

We bring you the big Desolate update! New combat system, new animations, improved enemy reactions, redesigned character appearances, and a lighting upgrade that will give you up to +20 FPS performance boost depending on your PC. 

New Combat System

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/cb226413d80e40ce96ff866e40d6a6bf54534bdf.gif

You've given us a lot of feedback on what could be improved in Desolate. In particular, you talked about how melee in the game could get better. You asked, and we delivered! Meet the new combat system in Desolate. 

New Kicks

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/7edfbf7029bd84fafe7acb0768fda11748c623fc.gif

Now, in addition to the usual attacks in the game, kicking appeared. By pressing the F key, you can kick your opponent and push him away from you. This way you can get time to choose a new attack strategy or to run away.

Counterattacks

Previously, Desolate had the ability to block attacks. After your feedback, we decided to add the ability not only to block them, but also to parry! Clicking the left mouse button right after a successful block will now damage your opponent and briefly stun them.

Combo Attacks, Accuracy and Animations

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/75c273659d96269512ba5d2e7ec01000f271f61d.gif

As we promised, Desolate is getting new combo attacks! Thanks to them, melee became more dynamic and diverse, and you can deal more damage. There are two combo attacks:


 Combo attack #1: Normal attack (left mouse button) + normal attack + kick (F key). The opponent will receive increased damage and will be thrown away at a further distance than from the normal kick.
 Combo attack #2: Block (right mouse button) + kick + normal attack. The scope of the final attack will become larger, which you can understand by the special animation of the camera! 


We've also added accuracy to your punches, so they don't go through enemy models. Plus, as you may have already noticed, there are new camera effects in close combat. This will add dynamic, cinematic effect to your battles.

Reaction of Opponents in Battle

In addition to the new mechanics, we have significantly improved the reactions of enemies to blows. Humanoid NPCs now have separate new animations in response to being hit. But that's not all! Blood effects on cutting weapons - are no longer an explosion of black liquid, but a directed spray of blood. 

It is important to understand if your hit connected during combat. Everytime your attack hits, you'll know by the way camera reacts and slight weapon jamming.

Updated Lighting and FPS Boost 

We redesigned the lighting in the open world and in some rooms. The light has become natural, and the performance of Desolate improved as well - on different configurations the FPS increase is from +1-5 to +20.

We will continue to improve lighting and FPS stability in Desolate throughout the year.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/c74d2560c1290b819eeed6e298d2cdcfc391d61f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/1ca0c8ed0a3e575d4fc2ebb1a75dc76bf58882eb.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/310577005aec03fbfcdf5ca5423d317fe7b34f1d.png

Appearance Options

Now you can play Desolate with a style. We have thoroughly improved the facial models available for selection, as well as redesigned the appearances of hairstyles and beards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/9857b292e25df0f12664832914ebe741811c80b8.png

What's Next 

Thank you for the feedback you give! It helps us make Desolate better. We will continue to improve the game further - now we plan to work on the game's balance, improve the open world and it's main questline and further the improvements of the NPC AI.

We hope you enjoy this big update and give us even more feedback and support. If it wasn't for you, it wouldn't be here!

Don't forget to subscribe to our Discord, where you can find company to play together, as well as chat with developers from Nearga: https://discord.gg/wYpBfgDD

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1 — bug fixes, information about Windows 7, ana Giveaway
notes.notes:
Greetings, Volunteers!

A new patch is already available for download. 
Ability to dupe ammo — fixed;
Bug concerning inventory interface’s focus on gamepads — fixed;
Removal of saved games now works correctly. 

Regarding Windows 7 support
We were informed that the developers of UE4 will not stop supporting Win7. They are aware of the problem and planning to fix it. Unfortunately we have no knowledge of the date of that fix. Once it is available we will update the game, so that users of this OS could also embark on the adventure in the Granichny Island. 

Giveaway

Do you wish to play Desolate with a friend but don’t have a spare key? Or maybe you haven’t got the chance to play it yourself? In this case we’ve got some great news for you: right now we’re giving away Desolate Steam keys!

How to enter: 


 Follow @HypeTrainD on Twitter 
 Retweet giveaway post 


And that’s pretty much it — that simple! For every 10 retweets we’ll be giving one Steam key, so the more you retweet, the more keys will be given away. Winners will be chosen randomly, and we’ll DM all of them on Monday, June 29 — please make sure to keep your DM open. 

By the way, the whole giveaway thing happens every week, so stay tuned if you’re interested in getting more of the HypeTrain Digital games for free.

Good luck!

notes.title: Patch 1.3 — Optimization, New Engine Version and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29823087/aaacc88920f142fccd31946de07de97f38884daf.jpg

Hello, Volunteers!

A new patch is already available for download. 

— The game has been transferred to the new Unreal Engine version 4.25.
— A performance issue caused by new versions of drivers for graphic cards has been resolved.
— Additional optimization of locations, ticks and lighting, influencing the loading of CPU and graphic cards.
— A bug with the customization save has been fixed (please note that if you’ve made progress in game and you want to change your character’s appearance, then after changing it use your last save file; if it’s not the last save file you’re loading, then for the customization to be applied you need to make this file the last, i.e. re-save it).
— Numerous minor bug fixes

P.S. Transferring to the new engine version can cause some peculiar problems, which we couldn’t track down after all the tests. If you come across them, we’ll be really happy to receive your feedback on our Discord server. If there are many of those, we’ll prepare a fix update.

Update 1.2.5, featuring new changes and improvements to DESOLATE is already here!

Below is a list of what was included in the patch:

 Finalized work on Item Sorting mechanic. Instruments are now included in the “Crafting” category, along with materials neccessary for item crafting. Added a category for item without a specific use (Junk). Ammunition can be found under the “Weapons” category.

 Materials (Snow, for example) would in some cases get layered on top of the weapon mod - fixed.

 Jump attacks would not attack Dorgs properly in some cases - fixed.

notes.title: 1.1 - Optimization, Equipment & Durability Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/4b1f609659b12c9e06cf489852232aad42e137c8.jpg

Greetings, Volunteers! 

We’ve cooked up a significantly sized patch, containing improvements & fixes to game’s known issues. 

As a result of your feedback on Steam Discussions & our official Discord channel, we’ve been able to pinpoint issues with equipment and items’ durability, along with other problems we’ve been able to settle in this patch. Once again, we would like to thank you for your overwhelming support - 1.0 had quite a number of bug-related issues, but because of you we’ve been able to overcome these issue and, step by step, making sure that DESOLATE is the best experience we can give you. 


Improvements & Changes 


 Global optimization work done on the whole Granichny island  

 Durability re-worked: we’ve added durability settings in the Custom difficulty settings. Also, we’ve increased ranged weapon durability to 25-30%, and melee weaponry by 20-25%. Remember: at any time you can change the durability values in the Custom difficulty. 

 Equipment mechanics re-worked: you can now equip/unequip items by pressing RMB on the item’s icon. Items will automatically go into an available slot, and if all slots are full, will replace the first equipped item.

 Sapsy Healing Salve  now heals 20% of your total health, and only heals light injuries.

 Owl-M2 now requires an X-workbench and Purple-Tier (Epic) items for crafting.


Fixes


 Issues with the color puzzle in Act 3, in some cases the puzzle wouldn’t work properly - fixed. If you’ve encountered this problem before, this patch should fix it retroactively. 

 In some cases, Act 2 and Act 3 would only begin upon restarting the game - fixed. 

 “Underground” Location - in some cases player used to fall through the terrain and die. Fixed - you are now being teleported to a safe location after the fall. 

 While looting, item marker didn’t automatically scroll up to the top of the list - fixed.

 Flamethrower attacker’s sound could still be heard after his death - fixed 

 Marauders used to run into the fire from their own Molotovs - fixed. 

 “Double weapons” in one hand - fixed. 

 Weapons didn’t show while the Player is in the safe zone - it’s not a bug, but we still decided to change it, so that you wouldn’t be confused


 One of the Teleport exit points wasn’t placed properly and resulted in Player’s death - fixed. 

 Kunai would disappear sometime after being thrown out of the inventory - fixed. 

 Interface prompts on the numpad lock weren’t localized in some cases - fixed.

 Secret sponsor’s box didn’t appear in “Severnaya” Safe Zone after getting the required perk - fixed

 “Regeneration” perk did not heal Back Pain - fixed. 

 Double weapons equipped by NL Captain - fixed. 

 Fixed loading issues in Bunker near the “Severnaya” safezone. 


 Marauders continued their voice line after death - fixed

 After incinerator’s death, his sound still played - fixed 

 Hunter’s ambient sounds now turn off upon his death.

 Fixed spots in “Oplot”, where you could hear the outside world, when you should not 

 > Added sounds to electric locks for granting / denying access 


 “Devourer” mod could not be created properly - saved. 

 “Oplot” could have some issues with loading - fixed. 

 Level design changes. 

 Issue with repairing the toolbox - fixed. 

 Perk master alchemist did not work correctly — fixed.

 Incorrect perk redistribution work - fixed.


To keep up with the latest news and updates, follow DESOLATE on:

notes.title: 0.8.83 — AI Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/d311ba500ffb65ea3e468d508e48dd9bd6de0b06.jpg

Greetings, Volunteers! 

A new update featuring improved enemy AI, gameplay changes and bug fixes has officially been released.

Changes and Additions


 AI Improvements - along with new animations for most of the enemies. These changes and additions along with combat improvements will make every battle feel more dynamic. 

 Third hit in a combo now costs 50% more stamina  

 The Dorg enemy now reacts physically to player’s attacks. 

 Vanoga’s health points are now increased. 

 Improved logic of player movement after sliding - if you hold the Sprint button after the Slide, player’s movement will change to Sprint; if not - the player will be in the Crouch position after the Slide.


Fixes


 While playing in co-op there may be problems in displaying enemies’ weapons - fixed.

 Dorg’s attack or QTE pushed the player far away - fixed.

 Enemies’ head had graphical issues while discovering the player - fixed.

 Issues with displaying Revive UI elements in co-op - fixed.

 Issues with elemental attacks, where you hit an enemy with a modded weapon and cause the element to proc, every hit with a non-element weapon will re-stack the element - fixed. 

 If during a stealth attack player continues to hold movement button, the player will run in stealth mode - fixed. 

 Blocked attacks cause stamina to decrease at the start of movement - fixed.

 Sounds issues in “Maniac” quest - fixed.

 Sounds for the Demolition Man work correctly in multiplayer and are synchronized with his actions now.

 A big ram leak was fixed.


And of course, if you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a review!

🇺🇸🇬🇧Please write your comments in English only
🇷🇺Новость и обсуждения на русском в официальном сообществе Вконтакте

notes.title: 0.8.80 — Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello, Volunteers!

A small patch, fixing some of the issues from the last update.


 You lose control during a slide, you can stop it with a block or attack; you can’t slide during a jump. 

 Weapon throwing is improved.

 Changed stamina cost of special moves. Added a new perk “Sensei” which decreases stamina cost of special moves.

 Improved flow from one move to another: for example switch from a heavy strike to a block is faster now.

 Problem using fist attacks while crouched — fixed.

 Problem using a stone or a consumable — fixed.

 Localization fixes. 



And of course, if you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a review!

notes.title: Updated information about patch 0.8.28
notes.notes:
Several hours ago we updated the game to  0.8.28. Unfortunately we had to roll back the changes, as it could lower the rank with other NPCs, delete blueprints and scrap. This is a serious issue, but we tried to fix it.

The new version is available on Steam, the version is still 0.8.28. The list of changes is the same.

If you did not start the game right after the first patch, then you will not experience any problems with it anymore.

If you did start the game with the previous version of the patch, then all your blueprints and NPC ranks should come back to normal. 

But your items in the stash and scrap can’t be retrieved, BUT we understand that it is a big blow to your time and effort, and we will work with each one of you to get you a replacement.

You can tell us amount of scrap you had, also we will fill your stash with the items you list, alternatively we can add a lot of high tier items to the stash.
  
To do this we will need your save files.

The best way to contact us about this problem is our Discord server: https://discord.gg/vb5Gv7y

notes.title: 0.8.28 — Hotfix, Game Pause, Skill Reset
notes.notes:
Hello, Volunteers!

There was a couple of bugs in the last patch. We fixed the known issues and added game pause in solo play. 

You can read the list of changes below.

New features and changes

— When you press ESC playing solo the game will be paused.
— You can buy an item to reset skill points at Misha’s shop.

Fixes

— There was a problem getting rewards for liberation quests, such as skill points, recipes and hats — fixed, all rewards should be added to your character.

If you still have a problem with this, please come to our Discord server and ask our admins for help there: https://discord.gg/7FGuWRC 

— Bug in the Zalegorsk quest — fixed.

— Bug with the burning the bodies task for the Farm quest — fixed.

— The locals did no damage to the hostile NPCs — fixed.

— Bug with the fires being uninteractable — we want to point out that the fires and crafting stations can be activated through pressing the E button. You can still craft near them opening crafting screen like before.

— AI customization was not working for clients during online play — fixed. 

And of course, if you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a review!

notes.title: 0.8.00 — Fast travel, UI update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/d630a77c2dcd608882908bba8e739bd5540da278.jpg

Hello, Volunteers!

New patch is here.

New features and changes

Pneumatic elevators are added to the game — fast travel system. After you fix it, you can travel to the second station for a small fee (this way you can only move along one line from point A to B and back).

We don’t plan adding free fast travel between all the locations, we think it will have a negative impact on the exploration and make the game too casual. With the current system it will be much easier to travel longer distances if you need it. 

Updated UI for crafting and inventory — we received a lot of feedback about clarity of craftable items and item descriptions in the inventory. We tried to fix the problems and make these screens more friendly.

The ruptures will change their positions more frequently during a session.

Changed the starting screens of the game ( you can skip logos).

Changes to the custom settings UI — we have changed the names and descriptions of different options. Players should be able to understand what each option means now. 

Optimization of many assets.

Increased quality of icons in the UI. 


Fixes

Ranged weapons had problems with the durability in the UI — fixed.

Small fixes to several sounds.

Small fixes in several locations.

There was a problem with the interface in the prologue, some items could not be looted because of it — fixed.

If the special animal needed for a side quest ran away too far, players could not find it after a restart of the game — changed, now the animal will respawn in its initial spawn point at the start of the game.

It was impossible to make a modification using the Stick from the bunker alpha — fixed.


And of course, if you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a review!

notes.title: 0.7.88 — NL Incinerator, Demolition Man, Dorg update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/d52f580d179ebdbe31ba9a6a1e7cb2c3b3b3374c.jpg

Hello, Volunteers!

New patch is already here.

New features and changes

New Light soldiers receive reinforcements — NL Incinerator.

Among marauders you can meet a demolition man — be careful with him and don’t let him get close.

Dorg: 

— QTE animation and interaction are updated (we know about the problem with the sound playback during QTE-animation, and we are working to fix the issue);
— chance and debuff period are lowered for the QTE.

Oasis NPCs received new animations.

Throwing weapons had their damage increased: grenades by 40%; kunai by 50%; molotovs by 25% ( the damage frequency is increased by 40% and damage zone lifetime decreased by 50%).

Chance to be set on fire is lowered by 30% and its damage is decreased by 25%.

You can encounter small scale events where opposing factions fight each other in different locations.

Added inverse kinematics to all AIs (their legs should adapt to the landscape).

Added new ambient music to the “Hospital”.

24 new tracks for the NPC with a guitar on the territory of the “Oasis”.


Fixes

Localization fixes and translation of some of the missed words.

If the key binding for the UV-flashlight was changed the hint did not take it into account — fixed.

Level design: 

— fixed several terrain problems; 
— fixed several floating in the air objects;
— fixed places where player could get stuck;
— optimization of several locations.

Broken tools were not correctly displayed on the crafting screen — fixed.

In the crafting menu when you press the button “Craft” modification slot is reset — fixed.

Sound: 

— if the player had a gun in his hands, there was no sound when the player was set on fire — fixed;
— several small fixes of the sounds.


Volunteers, this is the last update listed on the roadmap posted earlier. Very soon we will post the next development plan for DESOLATE.

Thank you for your support and interest in our project, follow the news here on steam and in social media!

And of course, if you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a review!

notes.title: 0.7.84 — Wanogah and Dorg update, level optimizations
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/48bc1155f40e601eeb0cc4eee4ecebf241bc3c16.jpg

Hello, Volunteers!

We have released a new patch.

New features and updates

Wanogah: added two new attacks(gas cloud and toxic bombs); wanogah can get on the walls and attack from a distance, you can make it go down with ranged weapons or stones..
Dorg: they have a chance to start biting your leg(QTE event). We would like to point out that current version does not have final animations and will be improved later. Extra animations need more testing and some changes to be used in multiplayer, they will be added in the future patches.
Saves: we have turned on the Steam Cloud saves.
Optimizations: 
— partial optimization of assets on many locations;
— improved optimization of the following locations: Oasis safezone, Ray-1, Hospital, Radar Station “Dome”, Southern Bay Piers.


Fixes

Meds, food, water, etc add a percentage of the parameter without any regard to the perks which increased them — fixed.
Numerous localization fixes.


Answers to frequently asked questions

When will optimization be improved?

We are constantly working on optimizations. At the same time we have started analyzing all the aspects of the game to find the most performance heavy items to improve the situation.

When will you add new quests?

We are working according to the roadmap we have posted earlier. The roadmap describes all the patches planned until the end of April.

Soon we will post the next roadmap, where we will describe the following changes and periods of the development. It will contain information about main quest and side quests. We will start working according to that roadmap after the last patch described in the previous one. 

When will you add more space to the personal stash or make team stashes? 

We have described the problem we encountered with the infinite stashes. Many people experienced problems with performance and multiplayer connection due to too many items in the stash. This problem was not solved yet. It will be added to the next roadmap and we will make it a separate task to leave extra time for the programmers..

The same can be said about the team stash and possibility of adding it into the game.

And of course, if you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a review!

🇺🇸🇬🇧Please write your comments in English only
🇷🇺Новость и обсуждения на русском в официальном сообществе Вконтакте

notes.title: 0.7.80 — Grutch update, new combat animations, location updates and more
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/3e9d6508be48630513df9bc357bc00f09bfd134d.gif

Hello, Volunteers!

New patch is live. Grutch AI update, new combat animations and several other changes we will describe lower in the text.

New features and changes

We have updated grutch — it has new attack types and debuffs during the fight, be careful dealing with them. 
There are new attack animations for player character — we have added new strike animations when you move to the sides..
Safe zone “Oasis” was updated.
You can trade with all NPCs in the safezone “Oasis”. But they have less goods for sale compared to the trader. Don’t forget about Uncle Misha.
The models for ice modifications were changed. List of modifications: “Frio”, “Frio 2.0”, “Freezer”. 
The location “Southern Bay Pier” was updated — new lootable objects, changes to the environment, the monolith and crafting bench were moved to the cinema; if you die on the territory of this location you will teleport to the fire there from the bunker. 
The blueprints for modifications “Shoker” and “Radiator” can be found on the map.
All tasks in the journal have categories now.
If you have already learned a blueprint you will see that when you choose it in the inventory. If you already know the blueprint you can’t learn it again.
Rebalanced shotgun ammo recipe — it requires gunpowder and 100 scrap now.
The posters in your collection have subtitles when you look at them now.
Paranormal activities happening in different locations will be more scary. And we are not talking about stress meter of the character.
We have added a hyperlink to our steam forums into the main menu and to the ingame menu. If you have any problems or suggestions please post there everything, it will help us too. 


We would like to point out that with each patch enemies are getting stronger. Remember that you can always tune the difficulty using custom options.

Fixes
Alpha versions could have normal names  — fixed.
The poster №6 was displayed in the wrong place — fixed.
Level design fixes: 
— terrain holes; 
— several places where players could get stuck.
Anomalies did not react to stones — fixed.
If the quick use menu was opened and you press ESC, the interface would get stuck — fixed.

And of course, if you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a review!

🇺🇸🇬🇧Please write your comments in English only
🇷🇺Новость и обсуждения на русском в официальном сообществе Вконтакте

notes.title: Update 0.7.75 Coming Tomorrow, March 21
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/2d212d5c86c14bba8199fd2c39b18446a8d09cd3.gif

Hello, Volunteers!

Next patch will be out tomorrow. We need some more time to test and finish all the changes we have planned. There will be new types of weapons and enemies. Thank you for your patience. 

Here is a list of changes for that patch.

New features and changes

Localization to brazilian portuguese language.
Players can craft and use grenades, throwing knives, molotovs, flares, chem lights.  
In the equipment menu players can use the hotbar for items, you can equip meds, food and water, and throwable weapons in it.
We have added new interface element, quick access wheel where you can choose equipped weapons and items from the hotbar.
New class of madmen was added. They use torches and may set player on fire. You can meet them at night time. 
New light soldiers can set player on fire with the modified mace.
Marauders can set the player on fire with the molotovs. 
New QTE mechanic to stop the burning when enemies have set you on fire.
General improvement of the AI — blocking, attacks, debuffs for the player.
Improved group fighting for the NL soldiers and marauders. They can surround players and attack together.
Changed the sound of the max stress level.
Added the sound of a new trophy.


Fixes

Problems with the texts in interface and on the road signs — fixed.
Small fixes in the russian and english localization.
Several fixes of flying objects and places where players can get stuck.
Rebalance, optimization and changes to the radius of the sounds.


And of course, if you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a review!

notes.notes:

Greetings, Volunteers! 

New patch with the improvements for the marauders and New Light soldiers, custom difficulty and customization for the room.

Changes & Additions

Custom difficulty is now available when creating a server. You can change some aspects of the game the way you like it.
Marauders and New Light soldiers can use kicks now. It can counter you block or a heavy attack.
Marauders now use Molotov cocktails.
New light soldiers can use grenades and a new type of melee weapon (right now it is just a heavy weapon but in the next patch they will be able to set the player on fire).
Madmen kick attack was rebalanced. Previously they could use it even when the player used fast attacks, now they will only use it to counter blocks and heavy attacks.
You can buy some customization for your room in the Oasis shop now.
The rooms have player names in front of them.


Fixes

Boxes with crafting parts were still given as a reward for some quests — fixed.
No symbols on the road signs in some languages — fixed.
During the main quest in the Podzemka facility the trigger which opened doors did not work correctly — fixed.
In the last quest enemies did not spawn during alarm — fixed.
In the craft section the durability of the backpack and armor was negative — fixed.
Trophies could not be researched from lootable objects — fixed.
In some cases the posters did not appear in the room after being collected by the player — fixed.
Broken tools did not have any visuals to show their durability is 0 — now they become red when you can’t use them anymore for craft.
15 places with wrong side of the stones or cliffs visible.
6 places where enemies could get stuck.
10 objects above ground.
4 places where players could get stuck. A reminder, if you are stuck , please report the place and write /unstuck in chat. You will be teleported to a safe spot.
Changed the loading volumes in the P.I.T. to fix the falling through floor.


And of course, if you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a review!

notes.title: Patch 0.7.63
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/cdfa929b247083e322d0fafb52429b7eaf2ded65.jpg

Greetings, Volunteers! 

New patch is here!

We have improved madman AI, rebalanced some aspects of the ingame economy, changed repair system and many other changes and fixes, you can read the details below.

Changes & Additions


Trader item and pricing variety re-balanced. 
Added Trader item rotation - items available for sale now change once a day (in-game). 
Added new Traders outside of Oasis. 
Quest (Main, Side and Daily) rewards re-balanced. 
Re-balanced scrap received for recycling and used for item repair. 
Changes to Weapon Repair system - you can repair items a limited amount of times (the amount is based on weapon rarity), and the durability itself represents amount of hits.  Damage penalty happens on weapon break (zero durability). 
Improvements to enemy’s “Sight” and “Detection” mechanics.
Madman improvements - new attacks, added variety, overall damage increase 
Sapsi is now more aggressive 
Respawn rate of all the enemies in the “Hospital” location was increased. 
Creature Trophies now can be “Researched”, which increases the creature’s rank in Monstrum 
You can now craft Bullets - the item recipe and ingredients are sold by Mikhail (chance to appear in rotation)
Backpack tier 3 recipe added - you can find it in “Chernovsk” location. 
Unseen before paranormal entities and events now roam the Island. 
Some mod ingredients now spawn more often. 
Recipes for Tier 2 - Tier 4 Armor and Mods reworked 
Enemies now no longer drop “Boxes of Scrap” 
Locked chests now have a bigger rate of having rarer items inside. 
Prologue reworked, Victor Ognin voice-over changes, some dialogue duration decreased.
Added new sound-based “scares”, which will now show up across the Island. 
Enemies now enter the attack-specific animation by chance, not every time an attack lands. 


Fixes


Localisation fixes and improvements
Level design fixes: more than 20 problematics spots fixed - places where a Player could get stuck, holes in the terrain, items flying in the air etc. 
Sound fixes: Madman sound effects re-sampled and re-balanced in terms of volume; re-balanced volume and duration of UI sounds. 


And of course, if you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a review!

🇺🇸🇬🇧Please write your comments in English only

notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29823087/af94292f2d5093e02c59e2f96838dce7bf424918.jpg

Hello, Volunteers! 

Yet another hotfix coming your way - this time mostly focusing on performance issues: crashes, freezes and the like. 

The full list for this hotfix can be seen below: 

[olist]Overall improvements to game performance, eliminating freezes, crashes and fatal errors
Changes to item names in French, German, Spanish localizations 
Madman no longer deals damage to a player behind him during his front attack
Fixed an issue where after fog-of-war progress would reset after re-joining the server 
Any negative affect on a food item is now highlighted with red. 
Fixed an issue where the “Revive” button prompt was not displaying properly  [/olist]

Thank you for all your feedback!

We’re going to release next update with first content improvement this weekend. Also we’re preparing a road map based on your feedback, so stay tuned.

If you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a positive review.

notes.title: Hotfix #1 - 0.7.44
notes.notes:
Hello, Volunteers! 

The game has launched but a few hours ago, and we’re already back working on it! 

Now, it’s important to note that we are aware of the issues some people are currently having with the game - such as the less-then-stellar voice acting, the game’s performance and networking troubles etc. Rest assured - those issues will be worked out very soon, and we will keep you posted on these updates as soon as we can. 

Fixes:

1. Fixes to incorrectly working resolution settings.
2. Fixed “Full HD” settings not working properly in “Windowed” mode 
3. Added a Fullscreen Resolution option - please note, users with Nvidia graphic cards and Windows 10 OS may experience graphical glitches. The official solution to this problem from Nvidia can be found here
4. “Strafe Left” command is now automatically binded to A button on keyboard.
5. Server select screen now scrolls properly
6. Changed the position of Generator quest item in Prologue. 

Thanks for all your feedback!
If you’re enjoying the game - please don’t hesitate to give us a positive review.
